scope: One post-hoc known harmful root, two candidates. Decode/observation-readout calibration only, not new harm, style/content isolation, state reconstruction, defense or generalization.
decision_rule: Inspect truth reconstruction before attributing physical facts to predictions. Record image errors descriptively; do not convert pixel or latent differences into physical state error or attack success. No retuning, new seed/root, extra model or full episode is authorized by this gate.
